title: Bounded constant-field objects have the same coefficient Tor bounds
statement: Let (C,J) be a small site in universe w and k a field in the same universe. For an object K in the standard derived category of modules over the constant k ring sheaf [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude], let a <= b be integers such that its cohomology vanishes below a and above b. Then HasCoefficientModelTorAmplitude K a b holds, with exactly the same endpoints.

source.place: Tags 08G0 and 08G1; modules.tex Tag 03ER; Bhatt--Scholze Remark 6.3.2

proof.text: Use the standard derived t-structure and Mathlib DerivedCategory.exists_iso_Q_obj_of_isGE_of_isLE to obtain a strictly bounded representative in the given interval.
Every term is flat over the constant field sheaf. Transport flatness from the monoidal tensor functor to the site tensor functor.
Apply the coefficient-model bounded-flat criterion to the representative and its localization isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientFieldTorBounds {C : Type w} [SmallCategory C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (k : Type w) [Field k]
    (K : ConstantCompletion.D (ConstantCompletion.constant J k))
    (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (h : ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q →
      IsZero ((coefficientModelCohomology _ q).obj K)) :
    HasCoefficientModelTorAmplitude _ K a b
